Title: Azure Digital Twins enhanced features are now in preview

Body.Content:
Create comprehensive digital models of entire environments to help gain insights that can drive better products, optimize operations, reduce costs, and create exceptional customer experiences with Azure Digital Twins Preview. Examples include buildings, factories, farms, energy networks, railways, stadiums, and even entire cities.

Take advantage of your domain expertise and use Azure Digital Twins to build connected solutions that:

  • Model any environment and bring digital twins to life in a scalable and secure manner.
  • Connect assets such as IoT devices, as well as existing business systems.
  • Use a robust event system to build dynamic business logic and data processing.
  • Integrate with Azure data, analytics, and AI services to make it easy to track the past and then predict the future. 

Get started building connected solutions with Azure Digital Twins today.
